proposed.explanation: Treats Additional Services as included; renderings and detailed cost estimating beyond CD requirements are expressly listed as Additional Services requiring separate authorization. Applies wrong rate and ignores authorization requirement; Additional Services require written authorization and are typically billed at a rate different from CA hourly rate. Inappropriately refuses to perform services; renderings and estimating are within architectural practice; the issue is whether they are authorized as Additional Services, not whether the architect may provide them. When the Owner requests work that appears to be Additional Services, the architect should immediately notify the Owner in writing, identifying the service, estimating the cost or hourly commitment, and requesting authorization before proceeding. Before providing unrequested Additional Services, the architect must issue written notice identifying scope, estimating cost, and requesting written authorization.
